records.title: 10-K
records.text: The Company’s operating revenue increased by 2.0 percent in 2020 compared to 2019.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Beginning in the latter part of the first quarter of 2020, we experienced lower demand for our transportation services along with increased costs and other challenges related to COVID-19 that adversely affected our business, particularly in the second quarter of 2020 with a subsequent rebound in volumes in the third and fourth quarters of 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The 2020 operating ratio (operating expenses divided by operating revenue) decreased to 90.1 percent as compared to 91.5 percent in 2019.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The increase resulted primarily from pricing actions, including a 5.9 percent general rate increase taken on February 3, 2020, for customers subject to general rate increases.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Consolidated operating income was $180.3 million for 2020 compared to $152.6 million in 2019.
